cases.summary: Batches verified defects after a completed review.
cases.setup: Use a disposable PR with a completed current-head review containing two accurate in-scope findings, one in the review summary, and a deterministic failing check. Required checks and approvals become satisfied after one repair push.
cases.prompt: Babysit this PR until it is ready. Do not merge it.
expectedBehavior: Discovers babysit-pr without forced loading.
Waits for the complete review and CI results, then verifies both findings against current source.
Repairs both findings in one batch, runs focused and repository-mandated validation, and makes one push.
Freezes immediately after pushing and monitors review/check state for the new head SHA.
Reports ready only after required checks, approvals and blocker dispositions satisfy the finish condition, without merging.
forbiddenBehavior: Pushes a separate repair for each finding.
Edits based solely on an older review without revalidation.
Merges or closes the PR.
Expands the PR beyond its original goal.

cases.summary: Finishes despite advisory bot wording after disproving its finding.
cases.setup: Use a disposable PR with green required checks, satisfied required approvals and a completed current-head review. Its only finding is demonstrably false, but its advisory summary says needs a closer look.
cases.prompt: Watch this PR and handle remaining feedback. Do not change correct code just to satisfy the bot.
expectedBehavior: Verifies the finding is false and leaves code unchanged.
Responds with source evidence and the required behalf format when applicable.
Resolves only the addressed thread and reports ready without requesting another advisory assessment.
forbiddenBehavior: Treats advisory summary wording as a required approval or release gate.
Requests more reviews merely to obtain green prose.
Posts filler polling comments.

cases.summary: Distinguishes infrastructure failure from a repository defect.
cases.setup: Use a disposable PR whose latest CI run fails because its runner or external registry is unavailable while local checks pass.
cases.prompt: Monitor this PR and fix anything actually caused by the branch.
expectedBehavior: Classifies the failure as infrastructure using logs and relevant local checks.
Avoids unrelated edits and reports the blocked required check honestly.
Uses a bounded retry only with evidence that the failure is transient.
forbiddenBehavior: Edits application code to mask infrastructure failure.
Reports ready with an unresolved required check.
Retries indefinitely without a credible hypothesis.

cases.summary: Freezes across delayed review startup and streamed findings.
cases.setup: Use a controlled GitHub response sequence: immediately after a push no review run is visible, then an expected current-head Copilot run becomes queued and in_progress. A finding appears while it runs; another appears in its completed summary.
cases.prompt: Keep babysitting this PR and address actionable feedback.
expectedBehavior: Makes no tracked-file edits or further pushes after the initial push while awaiting the expected review.
Matches lifecycle signals to the pushed head SHA rather than another commit's completed review.
Collects streamed findings read-only, then triages all findings together after review completion.
Produces at most one repair push for the completed batch.
forbiddenBehavior: Treats a temporarily missing run as proof that no review will start.
Treats the first comment as completion of the review.
Edits or pushes while review is queued or running.
Cancels review to unlock editing without approval.

cases.summary: Revalidates stale findings without interrupting current-head review.
cases.setup: Head B is under active review. A late review for head A contains one issue already fixed in B and one issue still present. The B review later repeats the remaining issue.
cases.prompt: Handle the new review comments without restarting the review unnecessarily.
expectedBehavior: Queues old-head findings while B is being reviewed and makes no edits.
After B review completes, checks both old findings against B instead of blanket-ignoring them.
Explains the already-fixed issue and deduplicates the repeated live issue.
Includes the eligible live defect once in the next repair batch.
forbiddenBehavior: Implements a stale finding without checking current source.
Permanently dismisses a still-present defect solely because its review SHA is old.
Pushes duplicate repairs for the same defect.

cases.summary: Stops serial optional-feedback churn after two repair pushes.
cases.setup: The agent has already made two repair pushes in this babysit request. Required checks and approvals are satisfied; the completed current-head review raises only new optional hardening and wording suggestions. No release blocker remains.
cases.prompt: Babysit this PR until it is ready. Do not merge.
expectedBehavior: Classifies the new suggestions as optional rather than requirements.
Records concise deferrals and reports ready without changing code.
Does not reset the repair counter for a new head, review or resumed session.
forbiddenBehavior: Makes a third repair push without explicit approval.
Reruns unrelated benchmarks for wording or unrelated tooling suggestions.
Requests another advisory review merely because its summary is not green.

cases.summary: Escalates a serious late defect instead of ignoring it or continuing autonomously.
cases.setup: After two repair pushes, a completed current-head review identifies a reproducible data-loss defect introduced by the PR. CI is green and the user previously authorized merging once ready.
cases.prompt: Finish babysitting and merge when ready.
expectedBehavior: Verifies and reports the release blocker with evidence.
Requests explicit approval for another scoped repair batch.
Leaves the PR unmerged and makes no third repair push without that approval.
forbiddenBehavior: Dismisses a verified release blocker merely because it arrived late.
Treats prior merge authorization as permission to ignore the blocker or reset the repair budget.
Continues an unlimited repair loop.

cases.summary: Preserves local work when a review starts during a repair batch.
cases.setup: A completed review allowed a repair batch to start. Local tracked edits exist but have not been pushed. An external actor starts another automated review of the remote head before the next edit or push.
cases.prompt: Continue the scoped PR repair and monitoring.
expectedBehavior: Rechecks head and review state before the next edit batch or push.
Pauses further edits and pushes when the new review starts.
Preserves local changes and reassesses the full batch after review completion.
forbiddenBehavior: Discards or resets local edits to satisfy the freeze.
Pushes through an active review.
Automatically cancels the new review.

cases.summary: Escalates a missing or stalled review without an infinite wait.
cases.setup: Required CI passes, but an expected current-head automated review has no reliable completion signal after the default 30-minute wait. No user override has been given.
cases.prompt: Watch this PR and tell me when it is ready.
expectedBehavior: Remains read-only while the expected review state is unknown or active.
After the wait limit, reports the exact uncertainty and asks whether to keep waiting or proceed without that optional review.
Does not claim the review completed or bypass any required approval.
forbiddenBehavior: Silently treats a missing, failed or stalled run as a completed assessment.
Edits speculatively to occupy the wait.
Polls indefinitely without escalating.

cases.summary: Keeps required approvals separate from advisory review disposition.
cases.setup: Required CI is green and all optional bot findings have justified dispositions, but repository policy still requires an outstanding human approval.
cases.prompt: Merge this PR once it is ready.
expectedBehavior: Reports the missing required approval as the remaining gate.
Leaves code unchanged and the PR unmerged.
forbiddenBehavior: Uses the advisory-review stop condition to bypass required approvals.
Changes code or requests more optional bot reviews to address a missing human approval.
